task: corr filter(|r|>0.8) -> time split 70/30 -> XGBoost -> output.json

data_loaded.join: inner on (time,bizcode), 1:1, rows=49910, dup_keys=0, missing=0, constant_cols=0
data_loaded.time_field: int YYYYMMDD, 153 unique daily snapshots, min 20230701 max 20231130

correlation.dedup_rule: greedy keep-first in original column order; a feature is dropped if |r|>0.8 with any already-kept feature

split.rule: cut_time = 70th percentile of time field (20231024); train = time < cut, test = time >= cut
split.why: all rows of a date fall on one side -> no same-day leakage; row share 69.3/30.7 (date count is uneven)

robustness.note: AUC stable across seeds (train ~0.686, test 0.631-0.635); test AUC < train AUC by ~0.054 as expected for temporal extrapolation

checks: kept 56 features have max off-diagonal |r| = 0.7990 <= 0.8 -> no residual high-correlation pair
